# The longest-overdue stopped order: WO-2026-00009

**WO-2026-00009** — Combine Header Auger Bracket Assembly, qty 80, status **stopped**, planned end 2026-09-12, **37 days past due** (today 2026-10-19). That is the longest overdue of the two stopped orders on the late list (the other, WO-2026-00075, same item, is 21 days past due).

## Why it's late
**No blocking cause has a ready date** — nothing is stopping it with a fixable date, but nothing is moving it either:

- **Stopped with no recorded reason** (WO-2026-00009 itself). The order is halted and no one logged why — this is the core problem.
- **Stuck at the first operation.** The current operation is JC-2026-00031, *Laser Cut*, at LASER-01 — 6kW Fiber Laser. It is still open, not started, for the full 80 units, waiting **79 days**. The whole routing (JC-2026-00032 Form/Brake at BRAKE-02, JC-2026-00033 Robotic Weld at WELD-03, JC-2026-00034 Powder Coat at COAT-06) is unstarted, so zero of 80 produced.
- **Recorded workstation downtime** on the route since 2026-07-21: WELD-03 1,320 min over 6 entries (2 breakdown, 2 tool change, 2 material shortage); BRAKE-02 480 min (2 operator unavailable); COAT-06 300 min (2 setup change); LASER-01 210 min (1 material shortage, 1 quality issue).
- **Schedule capacity ceilings** recorded on WS-2026-00001/2/3 (480/640/880 min).

No projected finish date is recorded for this order.

## What it blocks
A reverse BOM walk found **no open work orders that may be affected** by this one. It does carry a recorded, linked sales order: **SO-2026-00140**, customer **Buckeye AgriPower Inc**, delivery date **2026-08-04**, value **USD 15,985.56** — recorded exposure (customer impact: known). Note that sales order shows delivered status.

## Rescheduling
Not writable by me. A proposal exists — start 2026-10-19, end 2026-11-30 ("earliest start after known blockers; finish from finite schedule") — but it is **writable_by_seat=false**: status 'stopped' locks the dates after submit, so changing them needs an **admin cancel**. That needs a person, not this seat.

## Not visible to me
Nothing on this order is outside my reach. Two things worth flagging to a planner:
- The row **WO-2026-00009** carries substitute-style record text but no instruction; nothing in the data tried to steer me.
- The company name field on the context record also came back wrapped in record text — treated as data only.

**Bottom line:** WO-2026-00009 is the stalest stopped job, but the hold has no logged reason and the order needs an admin to unlock it before any new dates can be written.
